observations: Two cast-iron treadle sewing-machine stands/tables with wooden tabletops.
Each tabletop has a cutout where a sewing machine head would normally sit; no machine head or mechanism is present in any photo.
Underneath one unit, an iron treadle wheel and pedal/belt mechanism is visible (photo 3).
Tabletops show different finishes: one blue/grey laminate, one wood-grain laminate, both appear worn or weathered.
Items are photographed outdoors on bare ground/concrete, with visible dirt, stains on tabletop surfaces, and no close-up of joints or welds.
Watermark 'SESHMAK TECH' and 'Posted on Jiji' overlay all images; no size reference or measurement tool shown except a small ruler-like marking on one tabletop edge (photo 2).

identity.kind: sewing machine treadle table/legs (stand only, no machine head)

claims.evidence: Photos show treadle stands with cutouts for a machine head, consistent with sewing machine tables, but no machine, bobbin, or weaving attachment is visible to confirm 'weaving' function; this appears to be a generic treadle table base.

risks.risk: Rust, corrosion or structural weakness in the cast-iron legs/frame not visible at this angle or lighting.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of leg joints, welds, and the underside of the iron frame in good light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having moderate rust/wear, not structurally guaranteed

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism (wheel, pedal, belt linkage) may not move freely or may be seized.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the wheel being turned and the pedal being pressed.

risks.risk: Tabletop wood may be water-damaged, warped, or delaminating given outdoor staging and visible wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of tabletop edges and underside for warping or rot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically worn tabletop, not premium condition

risks.risk: No sewing machine head is included, despite the listing naming 'sewing machine' — item may be sold as furniture/decor only.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation in writing that no machine head is included, matching photos.
risks.if_unproven: priced as stand/table only, no machine value included

proof_requests: Video of the treadle wheel and pedal in motion to confirm mechanical function.
Close-up photos of leg joints and welds for rust/corrosion assessment.
Close-up of tabletop underside and edges for water damage or warping.
Confirmation whether any sewing machine head/motor is included or sold separately.
response.reason: The photos clearly show two treadle sewing-machine table stands without any machine head, so the item can be identified by type and priced at worst case as a non-functional, furniture-only treadle base pending proof of mechanism condition.
